title: ejemplo_sdv
summary: A small Python example script that simulates a stock/demand dataset and then runs SDV's HMASynthesizer to generate synthetic tabular data, evaluating it with SDV's diagnostic and quality-report tools. SDV's sdv.multi_table and sdv.evaluation modules are directly imported and executed to synthesize and evaluate the simulated data.
evidence: ejemplo_real_sdv.py:64-79: HMASynthesizer fit/sample, run_diagnostic, evaluate_quality all called on simulated stock data
